decisions.reason: As a visible extension of the firm's established psychiatric and therapeutic services, this program fits core capabilities and in an expanding organisation with slack there is little reason to exit after only an initial market test.

The carpentry workshop builds on existing workshop and production know-how, and a growing care provider would likely retain it while results are still uncertain because it supports both mission and resource utilisation.

Outpatient sociotherapy is very close to the firm's established support offer, so management would likely judge it against achievable aspirations and keep it as a low-distance expansion of the core business.

Its home-page prominence and strong fit with the firm's eldercare activities suggest satisfactory strategic relevance, so a behavioural-theory management would continue it rather than reallocate resources now.

Although less prominently presented, the retail shop leverages sheltered-workshop activities already inside the organisation, and with current expansion the firm can afford to carry this uncertain but complementary offer longer.
